# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 MistVVK and the XeStrata contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
"""SOURCE ONLY: integrated fresh-process guard-neutral campaign; Main resolves admission and executes."""
import argparse
import datetime
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import time

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from common import held_geometry, held_identity, request_budget_stop, admit, phase_health, closed, identity, load, normal_quit, require, sha, source_stable, strong
import mapping
from policy import (B, HERE, OWNER, OWNER_SHA, TREES, REVISIONS, BINARIES, NAMESPACE, SEQUENCE,
                    PACK, MODEL, NATIVE, PROFILE, FIXTURE, FIXTURE_SHA, PCI, DUMP, HEALTH_LINES, LLVM, ICPX,
                    argv_for, environment, cpu_cap)
from protocol import FAULT, DiagnosticReader, diagnostics, info, validate, compare_pair

UTILITY_ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
                   XDG_RUNTIME_DIR='/run/user/' + str(os.getuid()),
                   DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS='unix:path=/run/user/' + str(os.getuid()) + '/bus')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--engine', required=True, choices=['xe'])
    parser.add_argument('--phase', required=True, choices=[phase for _, phase in SEQUENCE])
    parser.add_argument('--qualification', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--qualification-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--fresh-health', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--fresh-health-sha256', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    for path, digest in ((args.qualification, args.qualification_sha256),
                         (args.fresh_health, args.fresh_health_sha256)):
        require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', digest) and sha(path) == digest, 'resolved Main receipt hash')
    production = load(HERE / 'production-source-pins.json')
    q = load(args.qualification)
    e = phase_health(admit(q, args.engine, production), args.phase)
    require(Path(sys.executable).resolve() == identity(q['tools']['python']).resolve(), 'actual qualified interpreter')
    expected_health_env = environment(args.engine, args.phase == 'startup' or args.phase.startswith('debug'), e['extra_runtime_dirs'], args.phase)
    fresh = closed(load(args.fresh_health))
    boot = Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()
    require(fresh.get('boot_id') == boot and fresh.get('engine') == args.engine and
            fresh.get('main_reviewed') is True and fresh.get('binary') == e['health_binary'] and
            fresh.get('mapped_libraries') == e['health_libraries'] and fresh.get('kernel_gate_passed') is True and
            fresh.get('reset_executed') is False and fresh.get('retry_count') == 0 and
            fresh.get('pci_bdf') == PCI and fresh.get('device_state') == 'normal' and
            type(fresh.get('level_zero_gpu_count')) is int and fresh['level_zero_gpu_count'] == 1 and
            type(fresh.get('selected_device_index')) is int and fresh['selected_device_index'] == 0 and
            fresh.get('health_protocol') == HEALTH_LINES and
            any(c.get('argv') == [e['health_binary']['path'], PCI] and c.get('environment') == expected_health_env
                for c in fresh['commands']) and
            type(fresh.get('device_used_mib')) in (int, float) and 0 <= fresh['device_used_mib'] <= 256,
            'fresh Main sameboot exact provider/health/device identity')
    ended = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(fresh['finished_utc'])
    require(ended.tzinfo is not None and 0 <= (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - ended).total_seconds() <= 120,
            'fresh Main health within120s; no pending/stale receipt')
    require(sha(OWNER) == OWNER_SHA, 'owner hash immediately before import')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qualified_direct_owner', OWNER)
    owner_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(owner_module)
    mapping.m = owner_module
    pair = (args.engine, args.phase)
    index = SEQUENCE.index(pair)
    roots = [NAMESPACE / (engine + '-' + phase) for engine, phase in SEQUENCE]
    with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        require(not NAMESPACE.exists() or set(NAMESPACE.iterdir()) == set(roots[:index]),
                'exact fresh successful prefix; existing failed root forbids retry/adoption')
        prior = []
        for root in roots[:index]:
            value = closed(load(root / 'record.json'))
            require(value['boot_id'] == boot and value['qualification_sha256'] == args.qualification_sha256 and
                    value.get('model_normal_close') is True and value.get('kernel_gate_passed') is True and
                    value['model_close']['quit_send_outcome'] == 'sent' and
                    value['model_close']['quit_exit_outcome'] == 'exit observed', 'sameboot normally QUIT closed predecessor')
            prior.append(value)
        if args.phase != 'startup':
            predecessor = roots[0] / 'record.json'
            require(prior[0]['engine'] == args.engine and prior[0]['phase'] == 'startup', 'same engine startup first')
            review = load(identity(fresh['startup_review']))
            require(review.get('passed') is True and review.get('main_reviewed') is True and
                    review.get('predecessor_sha256') == sha(predecessor) and
                    review.get('compile_diagnostics_reviewed') is True and review.get('provider_identity_reviewed') is True,
                    'Main reviewed actual startup diagnostics/provider before32K')
        require(q.get('integrated_campaign_reviewed') is True and
                q.get('clean_timing_environment_reviewed') is True, 'Main new integrated campaign/clean-env admission')
        out = roots[index]
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        env = expected_health_env
        argv = argv_for(args.engine)
        r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], guard_commands=[], boot_id=boot,
                 started_utc=owner_module.utc(), engine=args.engine, phase=args.phase, binary=BINARIES[args.engine],
                 qualification_sha256=args.qualification_sha256, qualification_path=str(args.qualification),
                 fresh_health_sha256=args.fresh_health_sha256, fresh_health_path=str(args.fresh_health),
                 production_source_manifest_sha256=sha(HERE / 'production-source-pins.json'),
                 controller_source_pins=q['controller_source_pins'], argv=argv, environment=env,
                 model_inputs=q['model_inputs'], startup=[], request_protocol=[], protocol_events=[],
                 ready_seen=False, gen_send_attempted=False, request_done_seen=False, model_normal_close=False,
                 mapping_snapshots={}, mapping_read_budget={'bytes': 0}, model_launch_attempted=False,
                 performance_eligible=False, full_context_runtime_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False,
                 validation_and_tracing_overhead=args.phase == 'startup' or args.phase.startswith('debug'), route_presumed_optimal=False, reset_executed=False,
                 retry_count=0, adopted=False, raw_text_budget_bytes=64 << 20, total_file_budget_bytes=96 << 20,
                 session_rss_budget_bytes=88 << 30, model_wall_seconds=300 if args.phase == 'startup' else 1800,
                 startup_wall_seconds=300, prior_receipt_pins={str(x / 'record.json'): sha(x / 'record.json') for x in roots[:index]})
        def save():
            (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
        save()
        owner = owner_module.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
        guard = owner_module.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
        r['commands'], r['guard_commands'] = owner.commands, guard.commands
        started = time.monotonic()
        cursor = None
        controller_wall = r['model_wall_seconds']
        r['cpu_affinity_count'] = len(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
        require(r['cpu_affinity_count'] > 0, 'positive actual CPU affinity')
        r['cpu_cap_recipe'] = 'ceil(actual owned wall * affinity count)+60 cumulative CPU seconds'
        def run(label, command, selected_env=UTILITY_ENV, interaction=None, wall=30, rss=4 << 30, cwd=None):
            remaining = controller_wall - (time.monotonic() - started)
            require(remaining > 0, 'finite controller whole-run deadline')
            actual_wall = min(wall, remaining)
            selected_owner = guard if label.startswith(('head-', 'status-', 'diff-')) else owner
            c, so, se = selected_owner.run(label, command, selected_env, cwd or TREES[args.engine],
                interaction=interaction, wall=actual_wall, cpu=cpu_cap(actual_wall, r['cpu_affinity_count']), text_cap=64 << 20,
                file_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20, rss_cap=rss)
            if label == 'engine':
                r['model_normal_close'] = bool(strong(c) and c.get('exit_code') == 0 and
                    r.get('model_close', {}).get('quit_send_outcome') == 'sent' and
                    r.get('model_close', {}).get('quit_exit_outcome') == 'exit observed')
                r.setdefault('model_close', {}).update(normal=r['model_normal_close'],
                    forced=bool(c.get('cleanup')), exit_code=c.get('exit_code'), owner_error=c.get('error'))
                save()
            require(strong(c) and c['exit_code'] == 0, 'normal anchored owned closure ' + label)
            return so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        def source_guard(label):
            require(sha(args.qualification) == args.qualification_sha256 and
                    sha(args.fresh_health) == args.fresh_health_sha256 and sha(OWNER) == OWNER_SHA and
                    sha(HERE / 'production-source-pins.json') == q['production_source_manifest_sha256'] and
                    all(sha(HERE / p) == h for p, h in q['controller_source_pins'].items()), 'immutable admission/helpers')
            source_stable(q['production_source_pins'])
            identity(BINARIES[args.engine])
            for pin in q['tools'].values():
                identity(pin)
            for pin in q['receipts'].values():
                identity(pin)
            identity(q['model_identity_receipt'])
            held_identity(q['held_out_prompt']['input'])
            identity(q['held_out_prompt']['preparation_receipt'])
            for pin in e['receipts'].values():
                identity(pin)
            identity(e['health_binary'])
            for pin in e['health_libraries'].values():
                identity(pin)
            for pin in e['mapped_libraries'].values():
                identity(pin)
            head, _ = run('head-' + label, ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
            status, _ = run('status-' + label, ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
            diff, _ = run('diff-' + label, ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', 'HEAD'])
            require(head.strip() == REVISIONS[args.engine] and status == diff == '', 'actual integrated clean source identity')
            for item in q['model_inputs']:
                require(mapping.stat_identity(Path(item['path'])) == item['stat'], 'full-hashed model identity unchanged')
        def kernel(label):
            text, _ = run(label, ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '--after-cursor', cursor, '--no-pager', '-o', 'json'])
            rows = [json.loads(x) for x in text.splitlines()]
            require(len(rows) <= 65536, 'finite kernel journal rows')
            relevant = [x for x in rows if PCI in x.get('MESSAGE', '') or re.search(r'\bxe\b', x.get('MESSAGE', ''))]
            faults = [x for x in relevant if FAULT.search(x.get('MESSAGE', ''))]
            r[label] = dict(cursor=cursor, relevant_entries=relevant, fault_entries=faults,
                            dump_present=DUMP.exists(), filter=FAULT.pattern)
            save()
            require(not faults and not DUMP.exists(), 'fresh kernel/devcoredump fault gate')
        def health(label):
            text, error = run(label, [e['health_binary']['path'], PCI],
                              selected_env=env, wall=30)
            lines = text.splitlines()
            require(lines[:6] == HEALTH_LINES == e['health_stdout_prefix'] and
                    all(x.startswith('LIBRARY ') for x in lines[6:]), 'actual completed integer health protocol')
            observed = {x.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for x in lines[6:]}
            require(observed == set(e['health_libraries']) and
                    all(sha(p) == v['sha256'] for p, v in e['health_libraries'].items()), 'actual health self-maps provider identity')
            require(not diagnostics(text + error)['severe_messages'], 'health selected-path runtime clean')
            r[label] = dict(protocol=lines[:6], self_maps=sorted(observed), provider=e['provider'])
            save()
        def capture(label, entry, poll):
            def partial(snapshot):
                r['mapping_snapshots'][label] = snapshot
                save()
            snapshot = mapping.mapping_snapshot(entry, poll, r['mapping_read_budget'], partial)
            for path, item in snapshot['files'].items():
                pin = e['mapped_libraries'].get(path)
                require(pin and all(item[k] == pin[k] for k in ('path', 'canonical_path', 'sha256', 'stat', 'elf_build_id')),
                        'actual mapped runtime/compiler/driver/stdlib/math identity')
            require(set(e['required_runtime_paths']) <= set(snapshot['files']), 'actual required runtime provider present')
            provider = LLVM if args.engine == 'xe' else ICPX
            sycl = [v for p, v in snapshot['files'].items() if Path(p).name.startswith('libsycl.so')]
            require(len(sycl) == 1 and Path(sycl[0]['canonical_path']).is_relative_to(provider / 'lib'),
                    'actual native SYCL provider, no foreign forced adapter')
            r['mapping_snapshots'][label] = snapshot
            save()
        try:
            require(os.geteuid() != 0 and not DUMP.exists(), 'unprivileged no existing devcoredump')
            source_guard('preflight')
            memory = {x.split(':')[0]: int(x.split()[1]) * 1024 for x in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines()
                      if x.startswith(('MemTotal:', 'MemAvailable:'))}
            r['initial_host_memory'] = memory
            require(memory['MemAvailable'] >= 80 << 30, '80GiB host reserve')
            groups = [x.split(':', 2)[2] for x in Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('0::')]
            require(len(groups) == 1, 'known unified cgroup admission, unknown limits fail closed')
            cgroup = (Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / groups[0].lstrip('/')).resolve()
            require(cgroup.is_relative_to('/sys/fs/cgroup'), 'bounded cgroup ancestor path')
            for path in (cgroup, *cgroup.parents):
                if not path.is_relative_to('/sys/fs/cgroup'):
                    continue
                if path == Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') and not (path / 'memory.max').exists():
                    r.setdefault('cgroup_memory', []).append(dict(path=str(path), maximum='root-no-controller-cap',
                                                                physical_reserve_bytes=memory['MemAvailable']))
                    continue
                require((path / 'memory.max').is_file() and (path / 'memory.current').is_file(), 'known ancestor memory limit')
                maximum, current = (path / 'memory.max').read_text().strip(), int((path / 'memory.current').read_text())
                r.setdefault('cgroup_memory', []).append(dict(path=str(path), maximum=maximum, current=current))
                require(maximum == 'max' or int(maximum) - current >= 80 << 30, '80GiB cgroup reserve')
            state, _ = run('embedding-state', ['/usr/bin/systemctl', '--user', 'show',
                          'llama-server-qwen3embed.service', '-p', 'ActiveState'])
            require(state.strip() == 'ActiveState=inactive', 'embedding service already inactive; no service changes')
            text, _ = run('kernel-cursor', ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '-n', '0', '--show-cursor', '--no-pager'])
            matches = re.findall(r'^-- cursor: (.+)$', text, re.M)
            require(len(matches) == 1, 'fresh journal cursor before any health/model GPU work')
            cursor = matches[0]
            r['kernel_cursor_before'] = cursor
            kernel('kernel-before-health')
            files = sorted(str(p.resolve()) for base in (PACK, MODEL) for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file()) + [str(PROFILE.resolve())]
            require(files == [x['path'] for x in q['model_inputs']] and str(NATIVE.resolve()) in files,
                    'complete exact canonical pack/native/PLE/profile set; no MTP artifacts')
            if args.phase != 'startup':
                require(sha(FIXTURE) == FIXTURE_SHA, 'exact immutable64K fixture')
                ids = [int(x) for x in re.split(r'[\s,]+', FIXTURE.read_text().strip())]
                require(len(ids) == 65536 and all(0 <= x < 248320 for x in ids), 'complete canonical fixture count/bounds')
                tail = load(FIXTURE.with_name('manifest.json'))
                require(sha(FIXTURE.with_name('manifest.json')) == '0fbf6a16a90b55a3767145d1217b2027e218c0537a487faa428ab6527e6771b1' and
                        tail['passed'] is True and tail['active'] is False and tail['suffix']['tokens'] == 49 and
                        tail['suffix']['encode_exact'] is True and tail['suffix']['decode_exact'] is True, 'verified49 task tail')
                tokens = ids[:32768 - 49] + ids[-49:]
                if args.phase.startswith('heldout'):
                    held = q['held_out_prompt']
                    require(held.get('main_reviewed') is True and held.get('held_out') is True,
                            'Main independently held-out prompt identity')
                    held_path = held_identity(held['input'])
                    tokens = [int(x) for x in re.split(r'[\s,]+', held_path.read_text().strip())]
                    expected_held = held_geometry(held)
                    require(len(tokens) == expected_held and 32768 <= len(tokens) <= 65536 and
                            all(0 <= x < 248320 for x in tokens), 'held-out whole-document actual geometry/vocabulary bounds')
                    require(tokens != ids[:32768 - 49] + ids[-49:], 'held-out differs from campaign prompt')
                (out / 'tokens.txt').write_text(','.join(map(str, tokens)) + '\n')
                r['input'] = dict(path=str(out / 'tokens.txt'), sha256=sha(out / 'tokens.txt'), tokens=len(tokens),
                                  parent_path=str(FIXTURE), parent_sha256=FIXTURE_SHA,
                                  derivation='first32719 IDs plus last49 IDs; no retokenization')
                if args.phase.startswith('heldout'):
                    r['input'].update(parent_path=str(held_path), parent_sha256=held['input']['sha256'],
                                      preparation_receipt=held['preparation_receipt'],
                                      derivation='Main reviewed entire independent held-out IDs; no truncation/splice/padding/retokenization')
            health('health-before')
            kernel('kernel-after-prehealth')
            admitted_at = time.monotonic()
            stderr = out / 'commands/engine.stderr'
            def post_ready_diagnostics():
                with stderr.open('rb') as stream:
                    stream.seek(r['ready_stderr_offset'])
                    text = stream.read((64 << 20) + 1)
                require(len(text) <= 64 << 20, 'post-READY diagnostic byte cap')
                return diagnostics(text.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
            def body(io, entry):
                owner_poll = io.poll
                next_progress = time.monotonic() + 30
                next_diagnostic = 0.0
                monitor = None
                def poll():
                    nonlocal next_progress, next_diagnostic
                    request_budget_stop(io, entry, r, save, time.monotonic())
                    owner_poll()
                    if monitor is not None and time.monotonic() >= next_diagnostic:
                        observed = monitor.check(stderr)
                        if observed['severe_messages']:
                            r['active_runtime_failure_diagnostics'] = observed
                            save()
                            raise ValueError('active post-READY runtime error')
                        next_diagnostic = time.monotonic() + 1
                    if time.monotonic() >= next_progress:
                        elapsed = time.monotonic() - entry['spawn_begin_monotonic']
                        size = stderr.stat().st_size
                        r.setdefault('owned_progress', []).append(dict(elapsed_seconds=elapsed, stderr_bytes=size))
                        require(len(r['owned_progress']) <= 64, 'finite progress samples')
                        print(f'OWNED PROGRESS {args.engine} {args.phase} elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s stderr_bytes={size}', flush=True)
                        save()
                        next_progress = time.monotonic() + 30
                    require(not DUMP.exists(), 'new devcoredump stops engine')
                io.poll = poll
                try:
                    require(time.monotonic() - admitted_at < 30, 'fresh in-controller health launch')
                    startup_deadline = entry['spawn_begin_monotonic'] + 300
                    while True:
                        remaining = startup_deadline - time.monotonic()
                        require(remaining > 0, 'absolute300s startup deadline')
                        line = io.line(min(120, remaining))
                        r['startup'].append(line)
                        require(len(r['startup']) <= 1000 and not line.startswith('ERR'), 'bounded non-error startup')
                        if line.startswith('READY '):
                            r['ready_seen'] = True
                            r['ready_monotonic'] = time.monotonic()
                            with stderr.open('rb') as stream:
                                ready_bytes = stream.read((64 << 20) + 1)
                            require(len(ready_bytes) <= 64 << 20, 'READY stderr cap')
                            r['ready_stderr_observed_bytes'] = len(ready_bytes)
                            # A partial line remains on the strict side so no enum can straddle and disappear.
                            r['ready_stderr_offset'] = ready_bytes.rfind(b'\n') + 1
                            monitor = DiagnosticReader(r['ready_stderr_offset'])
                            break
                    r['startup_wall_seconds_observed'] = r['ready_monotonic'] - entry['spawn_begin_monotonic']
                    expected_info = dict(e['expected_info'])
                    if args.phase != 'startup':
                        expected_info['expert_slots'] = prior[0]['effective_info']['expert_slots']
                    r['effective_info'] = info(r['startup'], args.engine, expected_info)
                    require(Path('/proc', str(entry['pid']), 'exe').resolve() == Path(argv[0]).resolve() and
                            sha(Path('/proc', str(entry['pid']), 'exe')) == BINARIES[args.engine]['sha256'], 'owned exact model executable')
                    require(Path('/proc', str(entry['pid']), 'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')[:-1] == [x.encode() for x in argv], 'actual argv')
                    actual_env = dict(x.decode().split('=', 1) for x in Path('/proc', str(entry['pid']), 'environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in x)
                    require(actual_env == env, 'actual complete explicit environment; no inherited secrets/flags')
                    with stderr.open('rb') as stream:
                        initial_stderr = stream.read(r['ready_stderr_offset']).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
                    r['selected_device_stderr_lines'] = [line for line in initial_stderr.splitlines()
                        if any(re.fullmatch(pattern, line) for pattern in e['expected_device_stderr_patterns'])]
                    require(all(any(re.fullmatch(pattern, line) for line in initial_stderr.splitlines())
                                for pattern in e['expected_device_stderr_patterns']),
                            'actual source-format selected device/backend identity')
                    r['startup_diagnostics'] = diagnostics(initial_stderr, startup=True)
                    r['startup_protocol_diagnostics'] = diagnostics('\n'.join(r['startup']), startup=True)
                    require(not r['startup_diagnostics']['severe_messages'] and
                            not r['startup_protocol_diagnostics']['severe_messages'], 'selected-path fatal/runtime gate')
                    capture('ready', entry, io.poll)
                    source_guard('ready')
                    r['post_ready_diagnostics'] = post_ready_diagnostics()
                    require(not r['post_ready_diagnostics']['severe_messages'], 'no new post-READY runtime errors')
                    if args.phase != 'startup':
                        require(entry['spawn_begin_monotonic'] + entry['wall_seconds'] - time.monotonic() > 90,
                                'actual owned deadline has graceful STOP reserve before GEN')
                        r['gen_send_attempted'] = True
                        r['gen_send_monotonic'] = time.monotonic()
                        save()
                        io.send(('GEN 16 ckpt=0 logprobs=5 ' + ','.join(map(str, tokens)) + '\n').encode())
                        r['gen_sent_monotonic'] = time.monotonic()
                        while True:
                            remaining = entry['spawn_begin_monotonic'] + entry['wall_seconds'] - time.monotonic()
                            require(remaining > 0, 'absolute model deadline')
                            line = io.line(remaining)
                            at = time.monotonic()
                            r['request_protocol'].append(line)
                            r['protocol_events'].append(dict(line=line, monotonic=at))
                            require(len(r['request_protocol']) <= 1000, 'bounded GEN protocol')
                            if line.startswith('ERR'):
                                r['request_error_seen'] = True
                                raise ValueError('selected-path protocol ERR: ' + line)
                            if line.startswith('PP '):
                                print(line, flush=True)
                                save()
                            if line.startswith('REUSED '):
                                r['prefill_end_monotonic'] = at
                            if line.startswith('T ') and 'first_token_monotonic' not in r:
                                r['first_token_monotonic'] = at
                            if line.startswith('DONE '):
                                r['request_done_seen'] = True
                                r['done_monotonic'] = at
                                break
                        require(not r.get('budget_stop_requested'), 'budget cancellation remains FAILED/incomplete')
                        r['post_ready_diagnostics'] = post_ready_diagnostics()
                        require(not r['post_ready_diagnostics']['severe_messages'], 'no selected-window runtime errors')
                        r['validation'] = validate(r['request_protocol'], args.engine, stderr.read_text(),
                                                    require_trace=not (args.phase.startswith('timed') or args.phase.startswith('heldout')),
                                                    expected_prompt_tokens=r['input']['tokens'])
                        r['host_wall_samples'] = dict(
                            prefill_to_REUSED_seconds=r['prefill_end_monotonic'] - r['gen_send_monotonic'],
                            decode_REUSED_to_DONE_seconds=r['done_monotonic'] - r['prefill_end_monotonic'],
                            ttft_seconds=r['first_token_monotonic'] - r['gen_send_monotonic'],
                            full_GEN_seconds=r['done_monotonic'] - r['gen_send_monotonic'],
                            scope='Observed protocol wall boundaries, includes pipe/scheduling/tracing overhead; engine DONE timings retained separately')
                        capture('done', entry, io.poll)
                        source_guard('done')
                    normal_quit(io, r, 'startup READY only' if args.phase == 'startup' else 'completed GEN16')
                    save()
                except BaseException as error:
                    r['primary_model_failure'] = repr(error)
                    save()
                    # READY idle, DONE, or an ERR response permits a bounded normal QUIT attempt.
                    if r['ready_seen'] and (not r['gen_send_attempted'] or r['request_done_seen'] or r.get('request_error_seen')):
                        io.poll = owner_poll
                        try:
                            normal_quit(io, r, 'preserved failure at responsive boundary')
                            save()
                            return
                        except BaseException as close_error:
                            r['gate_close_error'] = repr(close_error)
                            save()
                    raise
            r['model_launch_attempted'] = True
            save()
            so, se = run('engine', argv, selected_env=env, interaction=body,
                         wall=r['model_wall_seconds'], rss=88 << 30)
            r['final_diagnostics'] = post_ready_diagnostics()
            r['protocol_diagnostics'] = diagnostics('\n'.join(r['request_protocol']))
            require(r['model_normal_close'] and not r.get('primary_model_failure') and
                    not r['final_diagnostics']['severe_messages'] and not r['protocol_diagnostics']['severe_messages'], 'normal QUIT and selected path success')
            kernel('kernel-after-engine')
            health('health-after')
            kernel('kernel-after-posthealth')
            source_guard('final')
            require(all(sha(p) == digest for p, digest in r['prior_receipt_pins'].items()), 'immutable prior runs')
            if index > 0 and index % 2 == 0:
                r['pair_comparison'] = compare_pair(prior[-1], r,
                    str(roots[index - 1] / 'record.json'), sha(roots[index - 1] / 'record.json'))
                require(r['pair_comparison']['token_logprob_equal'], 'guard neutral token/LP5 fingerprint')
            r['complete'] = True
        except BaseException as error:
            r['error'] = repr(error)
        finally:
            if cursor and owner.active is None and guard.active is None:
                try:
                    kernel('kernel-final')
                    r['kernel_gate_passed'] = True
                except BaseException as error:
                    r['kernel_gate_error'] = repr(error)
            r['active'] = owner.active is not None or guard.active is not None
            r['boot_unchanged'] = Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip() == boot
            r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error') and
                not r.get('primary_model_failure') and r.get('kernel_gate_passed') and r['boot_unchanged'] and
                all(strong(c) and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in r['commands'] + r['guard_commands']))
            r['finished_utc'] = owner_module.utc()
            r['performance_sample_eligible'] = bool(r['passed'] and args.phase.startswith('timed') and
                                                     not r['validation_and_tracing_overhead'])
            r['performance_eligible'] = bool(r['performance_sample_eligible'] and
                                            bool(r.get('pair_comparison')) and
                                            r.get('pair_comparison', {}).get('token_logprob_equal'))
            save()
        if args.phase == 'heldout-on' and r['passed']:
            samples = [closed(load(root / 'record.json')) for root in roots]
            pairs = [value for value in samples if value.get('pair_comparison')]
            require(len(pairs) == 5 and all(value['pair_comparison']['token_logprob_equal'] for value in pairs),
                    'five completed pairs: debug +3 timed +held-out; either second arm')
            summary = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=False,
                source_only_implementation=False, model_runs_executed=True,
                qualification_sha256=args.qualification_sha256, boot_id=boot,
                individual_receipts={str(root / 'record.json'): sha(root / 'record.json') for root in roots},
                individual_samples=[dict(phase=value['phase'], passed=value['passed'],
                    input=value.get('input'), validation=value.get('validation'),
                    host_wall_samples=value.get('host_wall_samples'),
                    performance_sample_eligible=value.get('performance_sample_eligible', False),
                    performance_eligible=value.get('performance_eligible', False),
                    pair_comparison=value.get('pair_comparison')) for value in samples],
                prompt_geometry=dict(debug_timed=32768, held_out=samples[-1]['input']['tokens']),
                held_out_provenance=q['held_out_prompt']['preparation_receipt'],
                scope='Neutral reported16 tokens/LP5; debug/timed32K and complete held-out32768..65536IDs. Three timed pairs only; no full-logit/quality/256K/optimal speed claim')
            require(not (NAMESPACE / 'campaign-summary.json').exists(), 'new compact summary only')
            compact = json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n'
            require(len(compact.encode()) <= 1 << 20, 'compact campaign summary1MiB cap')
            (NAMESPACE / 'campaign-summary.json').write_text(compact)
        print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'engine', 'phase', 'model_launch_attempted')}))
        return 0 if r['passed'] else 1
